description: This file defines React components related to rendering labels and project/tag label views within a web-based test report UI, including handling clicks and styling.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: React functional component that renders a styled label, optionally as a link, with click handling and customizable styles.

classes.name: ProjectAndTagLabelsView
classes.description: React functional component that displays project and label tags with links, handling active project highlighting.

classes.name: LabelsClickView
classes.description: React component that renders a list of labels as clickable components, managing filter query updates on click.

methods.name: onClickHandle
methods.description: Callback to handle label click events, updating URL search parameters to filter results.
